sections.title: Plural sentences and a polar bear text
sections.titleUz: Ko'plik gaplar va oq ayiq matni

exercises.instructionEn: Rewrite the sentences in the plural, as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
GAPNI KO'PLIKKA O'TKAZISHDA UCH NARSA O'ZGARADI:

  1) EGA (olmosh)
       I    → we      (men → biz)
       you  → you     (sen → siz — O'ZGARMAYDI)
       he   → they    (u → ular)
       she  → they
       it   → they

  2) FE'L 'be'
       am / is → are

  3) OT
       ko'plik shakliga o'tadi
       ARTIKL (a/an) TUSHIB QOLADI!

NAMUNA: She is a doctor. → They are doctors.

DIQQAT: 'They are A doctors' XATO — ko'plikda 'a/an' ishlatilmaydi.

items.whyUz: Kitobda BERILGAN namuna. she → they, is → are, a doctor → doctors.

he → they, is → are.
'policeman' → 'policemen' (man → men qoidasi so'z ichida ham ishlaydi).
'policemans' XATO.
it → they, is → are, a cat → cats.
I → WE (they emas!), am → are, a singer → singers.
she → they, is → are, a girl → girls.

it → they, is → are.
'an armchair' → 'armchairs' — AN tushib qoladi.
I → WE, am → are, a man → MEN ('mans' XATO).
he → they, is → are, a pilot → pilots.

you → YOU (o'zgarmaydi), are → are (o'zgarmaydi).
Faqat OT o'zgaradi: a farmer → farmers.
it → they, is → are, a mouse → MICE ('mouses' XATO).

I → WE, am → are, a surgeon → surgeons.
'a surgeon' = jarroh.

it → they, is → are.
'fox' -X bilan tugaydi → -ES: foxes.

it → they, is → are.
'fish' — noto'g'ri ot, ko'pligi ham FISH.
DIQQAT: -sh bo'lsa ham 'fishes' EMAS.

you → you, are → are.
'an actress' → 'actresses' (-SS → -ES, AN tushadi).

he → they, is → are.
'an astronaut' → 'astronauts'. 'an astronaut' = kosmonavt.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in have got, swim, are, live, weigh or eat.
exercises.instructionUz: have got, swim, are, live, weigh yoki eat so'zlarini qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
MATN (to'ldirilgan holda):

  Polar bears ARE mammals and feed their babies on milk.
  They LIVE in the Arctic. They are about two metres tall
  and they WEIGH about 400 kilos. Polar bears HAVE GOT
  cream-coloured fur which keeps them very warm. They can
  SWIM very well because their front legs are very strong.
  They EAT seals and they usually live on their own and not
  in big groups like many other mammals. They live for about
  twenty-five years.

O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  Oq ayiqlar — sutemizuvchilar va bolalarini sut bilan boqadi.
  Ular Arktikada yashaydi. Ularning bo'yi taxminan ikki metr
  va og'irligi taxminan 400 kilo. Oq ayiqlarning krem rangli
  juni bor, u ularni juda issiq saqlaydi. Ular juda yaxshi
  suza oladi, chunki old oyoqlari juda kuchli. Ular tюlen
  yeydi va odatda yolg'iz yashaydi, boshqa ko'p sutemizuvchilar
  kabi katta guruhlarda emas. Ular taxminan yigirma besh yil
  yashaydi.

QAYSI FE'L QAYERGA — MANTIQ:
  • 'mammals' oldida → 'be' fe'li kerak → ARE
  • 'in the Arctic' (joy) → LIVE
  • 'about 400 kilos' (og'irlik) → WEIGH
  • 'fur' (tana qismi) → HAVE GOT
  • 'can' dan keyin → asos shakli → SWIM
  • 'seals' (ovqat) → EAT

items.textEn: Polar bears 1) ............ mammals and feed their babies on milk.
items.whyUz:
'X are mammals' — turkumlash qolipi (Coursebook 40-bet).
Ko'plik ega → ARE.

'live IN + joy'. Ko'plik ega → fe'lga -s QO'SHILMAYDI.
'the Arctic' = Arktika (Shimoliy qutb). Artikl THE shart.

items.textEn: They are about two metres tall and they 3) ............ about 400 kilos.
items.whyUz:
'weigh + og'irlik'. Bo'y uchun 'are ... tall', og'irlik uchun 'weigh'.
DIQQAT: 'they are weigh' XATO — 'weigh' bilan 'be' ishlatilmaydi.

items.textEn: Polar bears 4) ............ cream-coloured fur which keeps them very warm.
items.whyUz:
Tana qismi (fur) → HAVE GOT. Ko'plik ega → HAVE ('has' XATO).
'cream-coloured' = krem rangli. 'which' = ...ki, u.

items.textEn: They can 5) ............ very well because their front legs are very strong.
items.whyUz:
'can' dan keyin fe'l ASOS shaklida — 'to' va '-s' YO'Q.
Oq ayiq juda yaxshi suzadi.

items.textEn: They 6) ............ seals and they usually live on their own.
items.whyUz:
'a seal' = tюlen (dengiz hayvoni). Oq ayiqning asosiy ovqati.
'on their own' = yolg'iz o'zi ('alone' bilan bir xil).

sections.title: Revision: Units 1-6 — questions and there is/are
sections.titleUz: Takrorlash: 1-6 unitlar — savollar va there is/are

exercises.instructionEn: Write the missing questions, as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
JAVOBGA QARAB SAVOL TUZISH.

  Javob to'liq ma'lumot bersa   → so'roq so'zli savol
     'He's from England.' → Where is Tony from?
  Javob 'Yes' yoki 'No' bilan boshlansa → HA/YO'Q savoli
     'No, I'm not married.' → Are you married?

HA/YO'Q SAVOLI TUZILISHI ('be' bilan):
  Is/Are + ega + qolgan qism?

DIQQAT — SHAXS ALMASHISHI:
  Javob 'I'm not ...' bo'lsa → savolda YOU bo'ladi.
  Javob 'we are ...' bo'lsa → savolda YOU bo'ladi.

KITOBDA BERILGAN: 1 — Where is Tony from?

items.question: Where is Tony from?
items.whyUz: Kitobda BERILGAN namuna. Javob mamlakat → 'Where ... from?'

items.question: Where is Karen?
items.whyUz:
Javob JOY ('at the cinema') → WHERE.
'Karen's' bu yerda 'Karen IS' qisqartmasi (egalik emas).

items.question: How old is he?
items.whyUz:
Javob YOSH → 'How old ...?'
13 → 'thirteen years old' (yearS ko'plikda).

items.answer: No, he isn't a doctor. He's a dentist.
items.question: Is he a doctor?
items.whyUz:
Javob 'No' bilan boshlanadi → HA/YO'Q savoli.
Inkorda takrorlangan so'z ('a doctor') savolda bo'ladi.

items.answer: The Eiffel Tower is in Paris, France.
items.question: Where is the Eiffel Tower?
items.whyUz:
Javob JOY → WHERE.
'the Eiffel Tower' — Eyfel minorasi, THE bilan.

items.question: Are you married?
items.whyUz:
Javob 'No, I'm not' → savolda 'Are YOU ...?'
DIQQAT: I → savolda YOU ga aylanadi.
'married' = uylangan, turmushga chiqqan.

items.question: Is she your sister?
items.whyUz:
Javob 'Yes, she's MY sister' → savolda 'YOUR sister'.
Egalik olmoshi ham almashadi: my ↔ your.

items.answer: No, he isn't a barman. He's a waiter.
items.question: Is he a barman?
items.whyUz:
Javob 'No, he isn't a barman' → savol 'Is he a barman?'
'a barman' = barmen, 'a waiter' = ofitsiant.

items.question: Are you from Holland?
items.whyUz:
Javob 'we are' → savolda 'Are YOU ...?'
DIQQAT: we → savolda YOU ga aylanadi.
'Holland' = Gollandiya (Niderlandiya).

exercises.instructionEn: Use the prompts to make questions or sentences, as in the examples.
exercises.instructionUz: Berilgan so'zlardan savol yoki gap tuzing, namunalardagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI TURDAGI TOPSHIRIQ:

  1) (✓) va (✗) bo'lsa → TASDIQ + INKOR gap:
       There's a bicycle in the garage, BUT there isn't a fridge.

  2) Savol belgisi (?) bo'lsa → SAVOL:
       Are there any flowers in the vase?

THERE IS / THERE ARE QOIDALARI:

  BIRLIK                    KO'PLIK
  There is (There's) a ...  There are some ...
  There isn't a ...         There aren't any ...
  Is there a ...?           Are there any ...?

DIQQAT — SOME va ANY:
  some — TASDIQ gaplarda    (There are some pictures.)
  any  — INKOR va SAVOLLARDA (There aren't any posters.
                              Are there any books?)
  Aniq son bo'lsa some/any KERAK EMAS:
     There are FOUR boys.

items.answer: There's a bicycle in the garage, but there isn't a fridge.
items.whyUz: Kitobda BERILGAN namuna. Birlik → There's a ... / there isn't a ...

items.answer: Are there any flowers in the vase?
items.whyUz: Kitobda BERILGAN namuna. Ko'plik savol → Are there ANY ...?

items.answer: There are some pictures on the walls, but there aren't any posters.
items.whyUz:
Ko'plik tasdiq → There are SOME.
Ko'plik inkor → there aren't ANY.
'on the walls' — devor YUZASIDA → ON.

items.textEn: 4  a post office / in your area?
items.answer: Is there a post office in your area?
items.whyUz:
Birlik ('a post office') → IS there a ...?
'a post office' = pochta bo'limi, 'an area' = hudud, mahalla.

items.answer: There's a fireplace in the living-room, but there isn't a bed.
items.whyUz:
Birlik tasdiq → There's A.
Birlik inkor → there isn't A.
'a fireplace' = kamin.

items.answer: Are there any books in your bag?
items.whyUz: Ko'plik savol → Are there ANY ...?

items.textEn: 7  four boys (✓) / in my family / girls (✗)
items.answer: There are four boys in my family, but there aren't any girls.
items.whyUz:
ANIQ SON bor ('four') → 'some' QO'SHILMAYDI.
Inkorda esa ANY shart: there aren't ANY girls.

items.answer: Is there a mirror in your room?
items.whyUz:
Birlik → IS there A ...?
'a mirror' = oyna (ko'zgu).

items.answer: There's a dishwasher in the kitchen, but there isn't an armchair.
items.whyUz:
Birlik tasdiq → There's a dishwasher.
Birlik inkor → there isn't AN armchair ('armchair' unli bilan boshlanadi).
'a dishwasher' = idish yuvish mashinasi.

items.answer: Are there any flats for rent?
items.whyUz:
Ko'plik savol → Are there ANY ...?
'a flat' = kvartira (britancha; amerikacha 'an apartment').
'for rent' = ijaraga.

groups.explanationUz: Gapni ko'plikka o'tkazganda ega ham almashadi.
Ikki so'z chiziqcha bilan birikib sifat yasaydi.

patterns.formula: Ko'plikka o'tkazish: ega + are + ot (ko'plik, artiklsiz).
patterns.exampleEn: She is a doctor. → They are doctors.
patterns.explanationUz: Uch narsa o'zgaradi: ega, 'be' fe'li, ot. Artikl TUSHADI.

patterns.formula: There's a + BIRLIK ..., but there isn't a + BIRLIK.
patterns.exampleEn: There's a bicycle in the garage, but there isn't a fridge.
patterns.exampleUz: Garajda velosiped bor, lekin muzlatgich yo'q.

patterns.formula: There are some + KO'PLIK ..., but there aren't any + KO'PLIK.
patterns.exampleEn: There are some pictures on the walls, but there aren't any posters.
patterns.exampleUz: Devorlarda rasmlar bor, lekin plakatlar yo'q.

patterns.formula: Is there a ...? / Are there any ...?
patterns.exampleEn: Is there a mirror in your room? Are there any flats for rent?
patterns.exampleUz: Xonangizda oyna bormi? Ijaraga kvartiralar bormi?
patterns.explanationUz: Birlik → IS there A. Ko'plik → ARE there ANY.

patterns.formula: Javobdan savol tuzish: shaxs almashadi (I↔you, we↔you, my↔your).
patterns.exampleEn: No, I'm not married. → Are you married? Yes, we are from Holland. → Are you from Holland?
patterns.explanationUz: Savolni BOSHQA odam beradi — shuning uchun olmosh almashadi.

patterns.formula: X are mammals ... They live ... They weigh ... They have got ... They can ... They eat ...
patterns.exampleEn: Polar bears are mammals. They live in the Arctic. They weigh about 400 kilos.
patterns.exampleUz: Oq ayiqlar — sutemizuvchilar. Ular Arktikada yashaydi. Taxminan 400 kilo keladi.
patterns.explanationUz: Hayvon tavsifining standart tartibi (Coursebook 40–45-betlar bilan bir xil).
